verdict.rationale: The IPO's own pages say trade mark applications can be sent online ("You can send your application online or by post"). The patent page offers a "File online" route using One Login, and the IPO describes a suite of digital services to apply for, manage or renew patents, with the trade mark fee (£205) stated on-page. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that fee payment is completed within the online flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end online filing.
